_descricao: Nome e definição em inglês dos termos de esquema/vocabularios/ (D66), na mesma estrutura do grafo: relacoes, tipos_orgao e gerais.

integra.definicao: Is a component part of another body, branch or entity.

dirige.definicao: Directs a system at its level of government (e.g. the Ministry of Health directs the SUS at federal level, art. 198, I; Lei 8.080/1990, art. 9º).

supervisiona.definicao: Monitors and guides the work of another body or system without being its hierarchical superior, as a central body (e.g. the CJF and the Federal Justice, CF, art. 105, sole paragraph, II; the central body of an Executive system and the sectoral bodies, Lei 10.180/2001).

coordena.definicao: Organises the joint work of bodies that are not subordinate to it (e.g. the Ministry of Justice and Public Security and the Unified Public Security System).

subordina-se.definicao: Is under the hierarchical command of another body or office.

vincula-se.definicao: Indirect administration entity supervised by a body, without hierarchy.

exerce.definicao: Exercises the functions of a branch or body (e.g. Congress exercises the Legislative Power).

preside.definicao: Directs the work of a body or collegiate body.

auxilia.definicao: Helps another to carry out its functions, without merging with it.

ocupa.definicao: The person holds the office in the period shown. Each continuous period in office is one relationship.

elege.definicao: Chooses by vote who will hold an office.

indica.definicao: Chooses a name for an office or function; where the law requires, another body approves or appoints (e.g. the President nominates a Federal Supreme Court justice, whom the Senate approves; the President names the Government Leader).

forma-lista.definicao: Chooses several names (list of three, list of six) from which another will nominate or appoint (e.g. the MPF draws up the list of six for the STJ, CF, art. 94).

aprova-indicacao.definicao: Approves or rejects the name nominated for an office.

nomeia.definicao: Formally invests someone in an office.

designa.definicao: Chooses, among members of a career, who will perform a function for a set period, without a new appointment (e.g. the Electoral Prosecutor General designates the Regional Electoral Prosecutor, LC 75/1993, art. 76).

propoe-exoneracao.definicao: Asks whoever dismisses to remove someone from office, where the law requires such a request (e.g. the CMN and the Governor of the Central Bank, LC 179/2021).

aprova-exoneracao.definicao: Authorises someone's removal from office before the end of the term.

substitui.definicao: Holds another's office temporarily: when they are unable to act, absent or, if the office falls vacant, until there is a successor.

acumula.definicao: The holder of an office also performs another function, by force of the law, without a new appointment (e.g. the Vice-President of the TRE also heads the Regional Electoral Inspectorate, Res. TSE 23.742/2024, art. 9º).

sucede.definicao: Takes over another's office permanently when it falls vacant.

celebra.definicao: Signs treaties, conventions and international acts on behalf of the country (e.g. President, art. 84, VIII).

propoe.definicao: Has the right to put forward the proposal.

delibera.definicao: Discusses and votes on a proposal, or decides by vote on a situation the law gives it (e.g. the house decides on the arrest of a member, CF, art. 53, § 2º).

edita.definicao: Creates the rule by its own act, without a vote by another body (e.g. the President issues a provisional measure).

sanciona.definicao: Agrees to a bill that has been passed, which thus becomes law.

veta.definicao: Rejects a bill that has been passed, wholly or in part.

aprecia-veto.definicao: Decides whether to uphold or override a veto.

promulga.definicao: Declares that the legal act exists and orders it to be obeyed.

publica.definicao: Makes officially known a legal act (in an official gazette) or a report that the law requires to be disclosed (e.g. RREO, RGF).

regulamenta.definicao: Issues rules for the faithful execution of laws.

homologa.definicao: Confirms another body's decision, which only takes effect after that (e.g. the Minister of Education ratifies the decisions of the National Education Council).

classifica.definicao: Assigns a secrecy level to information, restricting access for a set period (Lei 12.527/2011, art. 27).

controla-constitucionalidade.definicao: Checks whether rules and acts comply with the Constitution and may strike them down.

suspende-execucao.definicao: Suspends, wholly or in part, the enforcement of a rule declared unconstitutional by a final decision.

autoriza.definicao: Gives the prior permission that another needs to act (e.g. Congress authorises the President to declare war).

susta.definicao: Suspends the effects of another's act (e.g. Congress halts Executive acts that exceed the regulatory power).

convoca.definicao: Requires another to appear or to provide information, or calls a meeting of a collegiate body (e.g. the President convenes the Council of the Republic, art. 84, XVIII).

fiscaliza.definicao: Checks another's accounts and conduct from outside: external control (e.g. TCU) or social control (e.g. health councils over the health fund).

monitora.definicao: Follows the execution of a plan, policy or system and assesses whether it works and meets its targets (e.g. the National Education Plan; the Senate assesses the National Tax System, art. 52, XV).

controla-internamente.definicao: Exercises internal control over another's management, within the same branch.

presta-contas-a.definicao: Must submit its accounts to another.

toma-contas.definicao: Demands and organises the accounts of whoever has not submitted them on time.

emite-parecer-previo.definicao: Analyses accounts and gives a technical opinion before the judgment, which is for another body.

aprecia-para-registro.definicao: Examines the legality of an act and decides whether it is registered (e.g. TCU with hirings and retirements, art. 71, III).

registra.definicao: Enters in an official register or grants a status, a condition for the registered or qualified party to exist or act with that status (e.g. the TSE registers party statutes, CF, art. 17, § 2º; the Electoral Justice registers candidacies; the Ministry of Justice and Public Security qualifies OSCIPs, Lei 9.790/1999, arts. 5º and 6º).

aplica-sancao.definicao: Punishes those responsible for illegal spending or irregular accounts with the penalties set by law (e.g. TCU, art. 71, VIII).

representa-a.definicao: Informs another body of irregularities or abuses found, so that it acts (e.g. TCU to the competent branch, art. 71, XI).

corrige.definicao: Investigates and punishes misconduct by members or staff (inspectorate).

autoriza-processo.definicao: Authorises the opening of proceedings against the holder of an office.

julga-recursos-contra.definicao: Reviews, on appeal, the decisions of another court, judge or body (e.g. the Social Security Appeals Council reviews INSS decisions).

julga.definicao: Decides cases or accounts, with final effect in its sphere.

concede.definicao: Recognises someone's right to a benefit and starts paying it (e.g. the INSS grants the continuous cash benefit and general-scheme benefits).

regula.definicao: Issues technical rules for a sector and oversees it.

exerce-poder-de-policia-sobre.definicao: Limits and inspects private activities in the public interest.

exerce-poder-disciplinar-sobre.definicao: Can punish misconduct by those under its authority.

gere.definicao: Administers a fund: decides how the resources are used and oversees management (e.g. Codefat manages the FAT, Lei 7.998/1990).

calcula.definicao: Calculates amounts that the law requires to be shared out (e.g. TCU calculates the shares of the participation funds, art. 161, sole paragraph).

tem-competencia.definicao: The entity may legislate or act on the subject, according to the type and nature of the competence.

representa-judicialmente.definicao: Acts in court on behalf of another.

assessora.definicao: Gives technical or legal advice to another.

oficia-junto-a.definicao: Acts before a body without being part of it (e.g. the President of the OAB Federal Council before the CNJ and the CNMP, arts. 103-B, § 6º, and 130-A, § 4º).

promove.definicao: Takes an action to the courts or opens an investigation in the public interest (e.g. the Public Prosecution Service brings public criminal proceedings, art. 129, I).

ajuiza.definicao: May take an action to the courts (e.g. those entitled under art. 103 file ADIs; citizens file a popular action, art. 5º, LXXIII).

poder.definicao: One of the branches of the State, or the people itself as the holder of power.

corpo-eleitoral.definicao: All voters, who choose representatives and take part directly (plebiscite, referendum, popular initiative).

legislativo-parlamento.definicao: Body that exercises the Legislative Power of an entity (National Congress, State Legislative Assembly, Municipal Council).

legislativo-casa.definicao: One of the houses of a bicameral parliament.

legislativo-orgao-interno.definicao: Board, committee or plenary of a parliament.

executivo-chefia.definicao: Body of the head of the Executive Branch or giving direct support to them (Presidency, Vice-Presidency, Governor's Office, Mayor's Office).

executivo-direta.definicao: Ministry, secretariat or one of their units, without legal personality of its own.

autarquia.definicao: Indirect administration entity with legal personality under public law, created by law for a typical State activity.

fundacao-publica.definicao: Indirect administration entity formed by assets set aside for a public purpose, under public or private law (e.g. Funpresp-Exe, Lei 12.618/2012).

empresa-publica.definicao: Entity under private law whose creation is authorised by law, with entirely public capital (Lei 13.303/2016, art. 3º; DL 200/1967, art. 5º, II).

sociedade-economia-mista.definicao: Private-law joint-stock company whose creation is authorised by law, in which most voting shares belong to the public entity (Lei 13.303/2016, art. 4º; DL 200/1967, art. 5º, III).

ramo-da-justica.definicao: A part of the Judicial Branch: Federal, Labour, Electoral, Military or State Justice.

judiciario-tribunal.definicao: Court or judge of the Judicial Branch.

judiciario-orgao-interno.definicao: Plenary, panel, presidency or inspectorate of a court.

judiciario-orgao-de-controle.definicao: Body for the administrative oversight of the Judiciary (e.g. CNJ).

tribunal-de-contas.definicao: Technical body that assists the Legislature in the external control of public accounts.

ministerio-publico.definicao: Institution that defends the legal order, the democratic system and social interests.

ministerio-publico-orgao-de-controle.definicao: Body for the administrative and financial oversight of the Public Prosecution Service (e.g. CNMP).

defensoria-publica.definicao: Institution that gives free legal assistance to those in need.

advocacia-publica.definicao: Institution that represents the entity in court and gives legal advice to the Executive.

colegiado.definicao: Council, committee or commission that decides collectively.

conjunto.definicao: Several bodies of the same type shown as one (e.g. the Chamber's committees). It is not a real body.

partido-politico.definicao: Private-law legal entity that organises political competition and fields candidates.

federacao-partidaria.definicao: Union of parties that act as one for at least four years.

paraestatal.definicao: Private entity that cooperates with the State or represents it by force of law (Sistema S, OS, OSCIP, professional councils, managers' associations recognised in law, such as Conass and Conasems).

organismo-internacional.definicao: Organisation formed by sovereign States, or one of its bodies with its own jurisdiction, such as an international court (e.g. Inter-American Court of Human Rights, created by the American Convention on Human Rights; International Criminal Court, CF, art. 5º, § 4º).

entidade-interfederativa.definicao: Public entity of the states, the Federal District and the municipalities together, not tied to any one of them (e.g. IBS Management Committee, art. 156-B).

sistema.definicao: Bodies of several branches or entities that the law requires to act together, without forming a new body (e.g. Sisbin, Lei 9.883/1999; Susp, Lei 13.675/2018).

escola-judicial.definicao: Official school for the training and further training of judges (e.g. Enfam, art. 105, sole paragraph, I; Enamat, art. 111-A, § 2º, I).

orgao-interno.definicao: Internal unit of a body or entity outside the Legislature and the Judiciary: inspectorate, ombudsman, secretariat, directorate or institutional school (e.g. MPF Inspectorate General, MPU Higher School, CGIBS Executive Board).

outro.definicao: Does not fit the types above; explained in the details.

povo.definicao: Holder of all power, which it exercises through elected representatives or directly (CF, art. 1º, sole paragraph).

executivo.definicao: Runs the State and enforces the laws.

legislativo.definicao: Makes the laws and oversees the Executive.

judiciario.definicao: Settles disputes by applying the law.

funcoes-essenciais-a-justica.definicao: Institutions outside the three branches that are essential to justice: Public Prosecution Service, public attorneys, the legal profession and the Public Defender's Office.

nao-estatal.definicao: Not part of the State, but takes part in how it works.

nacional.definicao: Covers the whole country, above the division into Union, states and municipalities (e.g. the Judicial Branch, the electorate, the parties).

distrito-federal.definicao: Federative entity with the powers of both a state and a municipality, not divided into municipalities.

estadual.definicao: Typical structure of a state; the exceptions are in the variations.

municipal.definicao: Typical structure of a municipality; the exceptions are in the variations.

ente.definicao: The variation applies to the entity shown.

municipios-do-estado.definicao: The variation applies to all municipalities of the state shown.

eleicao-majoritaria-maioria-absoluta.definicao: Direct election; the winner needs an absolute majority of valid votes, with a second round if needed.

eleicao-majoritaria-maioria-simples.definicao: Direct election; the candidate with the most votes wins.

eleicao-proporcional.definicao: Direct election; seats are shared among parties according to each one's vote.

eleicao-conjunta.definicao: Elected together with the holder, on the same ticket.

eleicao-pelos-pares.definicao: Chosen by vote among the members of the body itself.

eleicao-por-colegio.definicao: Elected by a collegiate body or college of which they are not a member: shareholders' meeting or board of directors of a state-owned company (Lei 6.404/1976, arts. 122, 140 and 143), CGIBS Higher Council (LC 227/2026), college of mayors.

eleicao-por-tribunal.definicao: Chosen by vote of a court, among its members or among judges of its court system, for a seat on another body (e.g. STF and STJ elect TSE justices, art. 119, I; the TJ elects TRE judges, art. 120, § 1º, I).

escolha-pelo-legislativo.definicao: Chosen by the Legislative Branch and then appointed by the head of the Executive.

nomeacao-com-aprovacao-do-senado.definicao: Appointed by the President of the Republic after approval by the Federal Senate. Also applies when the names come from a list (e.g. STJ, Federal Public Defender General): the list is recorded in provimento_nota.

nomeacao-com-aprovacao-do-legislativo.definicao: Appointed by the head of a state or municipal Executive after approval by the Assembly or the Council (e.g. members of a state court of accounts chosen by the Governor, where the state constitution requires it).

nomeacao-a-partir-de-lista.definicao: Appointed by the competent authority (head of the Executive, prosecutor general, defender general or another) from the names on a list drawn up by another body (e.g. the list of three for the constitutional fifth), without Senate approval.

promocao.definicao: Reaches the office by promotion within the career, by seniority or by merit.

nomeacao-livre.definicao: Appointed and dismissed freely by the competent authority.

designacao.definicao: Designated to perform the function for a set period, without appointment to a permanent post: career member (e.g. Regional Electoral Prosecutor, LC 75/1993, art. 76), member of a collegiate body with a term (e.g. Public Ethics Commission) or court auxiliary without a career (e.g. lay judge and conciliator).

sorteio.definicao: Chosen by lot from a group defined by law: registered citizens (e.g. jurors of the jury court, Code of Criminal Procedure) or officers (e.g. military judges of the Justice Councils, Lei 8.457/1992).

concurso-publico.definicao: Passed a public competitive examination, of tests or of tests and qualifications.

nato.definicao: Holds the office automatically because they hold another.

variavel.definicao: The method of choice changes with a condition; see the cases.

oficial.definicao: Confirmed by a legal act or official data in force on the reference date.

oficial-contraditorio.definicao: Official sources say different things; see the related warning.

secundario.definicao: Based on an unofficial source (legal scholarship, encyclopaedia, press).

inferido.definicao: Our deduction from the sources, explained in the details.

indisponivel.definicao: There is no accessible source: secrecy, lack of transparency or a gap.

lacuna.definicao: Information that should be public and was not found.

baixa-transparencia.definicao: Public information, but hard to find, incomplete or in an unsuitable format.

desatualizacao.definicao: Official source out of date with respect to the law in force.

ambiguidade-normativa.definicao: The legal act allows more than one relevant reading.

emenda-constitucional.definicao: Change to the text of a constitution (federal or state, depending on the entity).

lei-complementar.definicao: Law that requires an absolute majority, for subjects the Constitution reserves to it.

lei-delegada.definicao: Law issued by the President under a delegation from Congress.

medida-provisoria.definicao: Act of the President with the force of law, which lapses if it is not converted into law.

decreto-lei.definicao: Act with the force of law issued under earlier regimes; some are still in force.

decreto-legislativo.definicao: Act of Congress on a matter within its exclusive competence.

resolucao.definicao: Act of a legislative house or of a collegiate body.

decreto.definicao: Act of the head of the Executive, usually to regulate laws or organise the administration.

portaria.definicao: Act of a minister or head of a body that regulates internal matters or its own area.

regimento-interno.definicao: Rules for the internal workings of a body.

ato-da-mesa.definicao: Act of the Board of a legislative house on its internal organisation (e.g. the number of seats on committees).

ato-conjunto.definicao: Act signed jointly by bodies of different houses or branches (e.g. joint act of the Boards of the Chamber and the Senate).

lei-organica.definicao: Fundamental law of a municipality or of the Federal District.

provimento.definicao: Act of an inspectorate or a judicial council that guides and regulates judicial and extrajudicial services (e.g. CNJ provimentos).

outro.definicao: Another type of act; explained in the details.

pagina-oficial.definicao: Institutional page of a public body.

ato-normativo.definicao: Act that creates general rules: amendment, law, provisional measure, decree, resolution.

contas.definicao: Accounts rendered for the management of public funds.

acao-judicial.definicao: Type of case brought before a court (e.g. direct action of unconstitutionality).

decisao.definicao: Act that settles a specific case (e.g. judgment, opinion).

materia.definicao: Subject on which the entities may legislate or act (e.g. traffic, health, civil law).

documento.definicao: Other official document with a role in how the State works.

politica-publica.definicao: National policy, plan or strategy set in law that guides the work of several bodies (e.g. National Defence Policy, National Public Security Plan).

beneficio.definicao: Payment made to people who meet the requirements of the law (e.g. continuous cash benefit, general-scheme pensions).

tributo.definicao: Tax, fee or contribution that an entity may create and collect (arts. 145 to 156-B, 195).

fundo.definicao: Pool of public resources with a purpose set by a legal act (e.g. participation funds, art. 159, I; Party Fund).

receita.definicao: Money that the entity receives in its own right, other than taxes (e.g. a share in, or compensation for, the exploitation of oil, minerals and water resources, art. 20, § 1º).

regra-fiscal.definicao: Limit that the Constitution or the law places on those who tax, spend or borrow (e.g. prior-year rule, art. 150, III; personnel spending, art. 169; golden rule, art. 167, III).

regime-tributario.definicao: Set of tax rules: the National Tax System as a whole (arts. 145 to 162) or the specific regime of a group of taxpayers or a region (e.g. Simples Nacional, art. 146, sole paragraph; Manaus Free Trade Zone, ADCT, art. 40).

exclusiva.definicao: Only this entity exercises it; it cannot be delegated (e.g. art. 21).

privativa.definicao: Only this entity legislates, but a complementary law may authorise the states to legislate on specific questions (art. 22, sole paragraph).

comum.definicao: Union, states, Federal District and municipalities act together, in cooperation (art. 23).

concorrente.definicao: The Union sets the general rules and the states and the Federal District complement them (art. 24).

suplementar.definicao: The entity fills in federal and state legislation where applicable (e.g. municipalities, art. 30, II).

interesse-local.definicao: The municipality legislates on matters of local interest (art. 30, I) and organises and provides local public services (art. 30, V).

propria.definicao: The Constitution gives the subject to this entity expressly, without saying whether it is exclusive, common or concurrent (e.g. municipalities, art. 30, III, IV, VI to IX).

compartilhada.definicao: States, Federal District and municipalities exercise the same tax competence together, with one common complementary law and each entity's own rate (IBS, art. 156-A).

residual.definicao: The entity has whatever was not assigned to the others (states, art. 25, § 1º).

legislativa.definicao: Make the laws on the subject.

material.definicao: Act, provide the service or oversee the subject.

maioria-simples.definicao: More votes for than against, among those present, provided the minimum attendance is met.

maioria-absoluta.definicao: More than half of all members, present or not.

votos-validos.definicao: More than half of the votes, not counting blank and spoilt ballots.

secreta.definicao: Each member's vote is not disclosed.

nominal.definicao: Each member votes individually and the vote is recorded by name.

simbolica.definicao: Members express their view together, with no individual record.

decisao.definicao: Someone decides, and the path splits according to the result.

decurso-de-prazo.definicao: Nothing is done; the effect comes from time passing.

orcamento-executado.definicao: How much the body paid in the year (spending of the year paid plus commitments from earlier years paid in the year), with the approved appropriation alongside (D46).
